rows.jp: お花ちゃんたちはあちこち移動しているらしい。
rows.en: The flower girls seem to be moving from place to place.

ghs.en: Seems the Flowers are moving around here and there.

rows.jp: あの二人は能動的に行動しているようだが、理由はわからない。
rows.en: Those two are acting with purpose, though I have no idea why.

ghs.en: Those two seem to be very proactive in their actions, but what the reason is I don't know.

rows.jp: ノートにも触れられてはいなかった。
rows.en: There was nothing about it in the notebook either.

ghs.en: In the notebooks there is no touching on them either.

rows.jp: すでに学校にはいないのかも知れない。
rows.en: Maybe they've already left the school.

ghs.en: They might just not be at school anymore.

rows.jp: 無人の空間を後にする。
rows.en: I leave the empty room behind.

ghs.en: I leave this deserted space behind.
